decisions.reason: With the standalone shuttering and de-shuttering robots withdrawn, the combined robot is now the firm's flagship automation product, so management will defend this sunk R&D investment and blame weak demand on the temporary construction slump.
The profile storage robot is an integral part of the automated shuttering line around Product A and supports the announced automation direction, so it is kept despite possible slow uptake.

The newly launched multi-model magazining, cleaning and plotting line is a visible, recent commitment within the core offer, and it is too early to attribute any weakness to anything but market timing.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, underpins the publicly stated digital and automated precast strategy, and strengthens lifecycle service, so there is little reason to drop it.
